function.name: neighbors
function.description: Entities within `hops` (1-3) of ONE named entity, with the relation type of each direct neighbor.

function.name: passages_for_entity
function.description: Raw source passage text mentioning ONE named entity.

function.name: relation_between
function.description: Direct (1-hop) relation(s) between TWO named entities, either direction.

function.name: shortest_path_between
function.description: Shortest relation path between TWO named entities, via any intermediates.

function.name: triples_with_relation
function.description: All (subject, relation, object) triples for ONE relation type, optionally restricted to a subject.
